shared_elements: figure holding a long staff or rod
low-relief human figure with profile head and frontal-leaning torso
justification: Both depict human figures in strict profile wearing long garments and gripping an upright staff-like implement in carved low relief, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a crowded multi-register composition of many small interacting figures accompanied by dense sign-script and offering gestures, while B is a single monumental attendant with elaborate fluted headdress, spear and slung quiver filling the whole field with no accompanying figures or text.
